intent: Deliver Evolution Expert 1.1.0 as the independently versioned Agent-neutral unified Host entry for EvoPilot Runtime 5.1.0, generating thin Codex, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, generic MCP, and independent Host adapters that guide project onboarding, Suite capability migration, independent resource versioning, recovery, status, shadow and Cutover preparation without owning Runtime truth, Harness assets, authority, credentials, or durable state.
objective: Make one released generated Expert adapter the understandable ordinary-human entry in Codex and equivalent third-party Hosts, clearly distinguish immutable source Suite versions from independently versioned declarative resources, preserve independent Runtime/Expert/resource SemVer, and prove complete Host conformance, headless optionality, zero Suite dependency, exact authority routing, inherited compatibility, and NO_REGRESSION.

evidence.authority: Approved Roadmap design declaring Expert 1.1.0 unified Host entry; drafting authority only.
Current authoritative machine Roadmap with independent Expert 1.1.0 milestone.
Published Expert 1.0.1 compatibility and acceptance baseline inherited criterion by criterion.
User-confirmed requirement to explain and preserve independent Suite provenance, resource, Runtime, and Expert version lines; not Target approval.
Exact authority to draft and preflight this Target; not implementation, Host operation, or release authority.

include: Extend one Agent-neutral Expert Core and deterministically generate Codex, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, generic MCP, and independent Host adapters.
Provide ordinary-human discovery, onboarding, tutorial, explanation, unresolved-input, plan, exact decision, status, recovery, resume, migration, shadow, Cutover-readiness, and rollback journeys.
Explain and expose immutable source Suite identity separately from independently versioned declarative resources and their Runtime compatibility ranges.
Prove compatible project-resource upgrades do not require Runtime or Expert releases; version Expert only for Expert interaction or adapter package changes.
Install and test the released-shape Codex adapter as a thin client of supported EvoPilot Runtime contracts.
Maintain WorkBuddy as designated-human-only and validate independent Host and generic MCP conformance.
Synchronize Expert README, quickstart, tutorials, migration, versioning, Host integration, security, troubleshooting, and Cutover preparation documentation.
exclude: No Runtime, project, Lifecycle, recovery, evidence, acceptance, release-decision, credential, database, production, or durable-state ownership in Expert.
No Harness selection, fabrication, reasoning, authoring, mutation, approval, Catalog, Registry, or publication authority.
No embedded DataRig Suite, EvoPilot Suite, project-specific Lifecycle, or hidden fallback in any adapter.
No lockstep version coupling between Expert, Runtime, declarative resources, Harness assets, or source Suite baselines.
No Codex operation or observation of WorkBuddy.
No real Suite switch, archive, uninstall, deletion, or Cutover under this Target.
No commit, push, Candidate, Host operation, E2E, publication, or Release under an unapproved Target.

acceptance.criterion: Generate the released Codex, designated-human WorkBuddy, generic Agent, generic MCP, and independent Host adapters from one immutable Agent-neutral Expert Core.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Generation determinism, shared Core digest, adapter manifest, package inventory, and cross-Host conformance tests.

acceptance.criterion: Install the final released Codex adapter as a thin entry that carries no project Lifecycle, Harness selection, approval, recovery, acceptance, release, credential, or durable-state semantics.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Fresh-install package and static-boundary evidence plus Runtime-call traces.

acceptance.criterion: Guide ordinary users through project registration, Harness matching explanation, missing-input collection, plan review, exact authority decisions, execution status, recovery, resume, tutorial, migration, shadow, Cutover preparation, and rollback.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Dialogue scenario matrix with schema-driven questions and exact Runtime state projection.

acceptance.criterion: Expose the exact provenance distinction between source Suite versions and independently versioned declarative resources without presenting DataRig Suite 2.1.5 or EvoPilot Suite 3.2.1 as resource version 1.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Rendered explanations and structured output tests covering apiVersion, resourceVersion/revision, sourceSuite/sourceVersion/sourceDigest, and Runtime compatibility.

acceptance.criterion: Show capability ownership and compatible version paths: project resources evolve independently, Expert changes only for Host interaction/package behavior, Runtime changes only for Runtime-owned contracts or semantics, and Harness production stays in evopilot-harness.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Guided upgrade matrix and negative tests against lockstep Runtime upgrades or Suite rebranding.

acceptance.criterion: Ask only unresolved fields and route genuine authority decisions to the exact owning human without turning conversation, confirmation wording, or parameter entry into approval.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-Host unresolved-input and authority-decision conformance evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Support tutorial, doctor, status, explain, dry-run, resume, cancellation, migration inventory, capability differential, and Cutover-readiness views without mutating Runtime or project state unless an exact Runtime operation is separately authorized.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Side-effect-free command and interaction tests with immutable Runtime receipts.

acceptance.criterion: Continue using supported EvoPilot MCP, HTTP, or CLI contracts and remain replaceable, independently versioned, and unnecessary for headless Runtime execution.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Transport compatibility, uninstall, headless-absence, upgrade, and rollback tests.

acceptance.criterion: No Expert or generated adapter may choose, fabricate, modify, approve, publish, or own a Harness asset.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Static boundary and adversarial interaction tests.

acceptance.criterion: No Expert or generated adapter may own project truth, Roadmap/Target state, Lifecycle state, recovery state, evidence, acceptance, release decisions, credentials, database authority, production authority, or durable Runtime state.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: State ownership matrix, package scan, and live cross-surface checks.

acceptance.criterion: Codex, WorkBuddy, independent Host, generic MCP, and headless routes project the same Runtime truth, stop rules, resource versions, and decision digests.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Conformance report over identical frozen scenarios and Runtime receipts.

acceptance.criterion: WorkBuddy acceptance remains designated-human-only; Codex cannot operate or observe WorkBuddy.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Host boundary evidence and frozen human runbook.

acceptance.criterion: The released adapter has zero dependency on either legacy Suite and cannot invoke or fall back to them.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Dependency graph, filesystem/process trace, and Candidate environment with both Suites absent.

acceptance.criterion: Expert SemVer remains independent from Runtime and resource versions; compatible project-resource revisions require no Expert release, while Expert interaction or adapter-package changes require an Expert version change.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Version decision matrix and installed-version tests.

acceptance.criterion: Expert README, installation, ordinary-user quickstart, guided tutorials, Host integration, version explanation, migration, shadow, Cutover preparation, rollback, troubleshooting, and API/MCP/CLI routing match installed 1.1.0 behavior.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Documentation link/command checks and tutorial executions in released-shape Candidate installations.
